notes.title: Halloween Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


Happy Halloween, we hope you’re all enjoying The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication! 
 
Today is an exciting day as we officially launch the game on consoles, and we’re bringing this patch to the PC version to ensure it’s in line with the console release. This update focuses on improving the overall gameplay experience, fixing some minor bugs, and introducing a few quality-of-life tweaks.

Patch Highlights for Update Ver.1.7.2

System

 Updated the video codec.

Optimisation

 Enhanced the spatial perception of the voice and sound effects.
 Updated the game's credits.
 Optimised multiple UI button prompts.
 Optimised Localisation for several languages.
 Optimised memory usage for textures.

General Fixes

 Fixed an error where the master tape became uninteractive after loading a saved game.
 Fixed an error where 'The Dark One' did not see A-Hai in specific situations.
 Fixed an issue where videos would play before being revealed properly.
 Fixed subtitles that were not properly closed during calls.

We’re committed to making The Bridge Curse 2 the best experience possible, so keep your feedback coming! Let us know how you’re finding the game.

Thanks for your continued support and Happy Halloween! 

— The Bridge Curse 2 Team

notes.title: RESOLVED: Patch to solve the black screen issue now live
notes.content:
A patch is now live, resolving the black screen start-up issue!

Players, please update the game to v1.6.3, which will solve the black screen problem.

We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused to players.

We are currently continuing to resolve audio and voice issues, thank you very much for your patience and understanding.


We've identified a launch issue affecting a small subset of players booting The Bridge Curse 2: The Extraction. Rest assured, we're actively developing a patch to resolve this promptly.

In the interim, to get you back into the game smoothly, we recommend trying these troubleshooting steps. 

For a quick fix, many players have found success by downloading and installing the VP9 Video Extensions available on the Microsoft Store.

Additionally, consider these options:

1. If you have third-party video player software installed, we advise either uninstalling it or disabling it temporarily.

2. For Windows 10 users, ensure your system is updated to at least version 1809.

3. If your computer has both an independent GPU and a built-in GPU, we recommend disabling the one not in use currently.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to resolve this.

notes.title: Survive The Night In 'The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication', Out Now On Steam!
notes.content:
We are extremely excited to announce that The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication' is out now on Steam! PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, GOG, and Epic Games Store coming later this year.

Buy now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331330/The_Bridge_Curse_2_The_Extrication/

Try to escape with your life in a first-person survival horror adventure set within 'Wen Hua University', renowned in Taiwan for its ghost tales & folklore. Play through the eyes of four distinct characters as you evade and confront terrifying ghosts, unravel mind-bending puzzles, and unearth a sinister conspiracy... Will you survive the night, or become the latest victim of the curse? 

Class Is In Session... Intent on resurrecting a decades-old campus ghost story, a daring group of film club students orchestrates the 'Carnival of Horror ' within the infamously haunted 'Da Ren' building. As they begin to film, the line between fiction and reality blurs, and inexplicable events begin to unfold…. 

Outwit and Evade Relentless Pursuers: Formidable ghosts lurk in the shadow-drenched halls of Wen Hua. Stifle every gasp, swallow every whimper as the labyrinthine halls amplify every sound. Confront or divert your stalker's attention as you desperately try and survive the night. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/9823e2e557ef6c37509aa25841ab889782058b16.png

A Memorable Cast of Characters: Play as four distinct characters and encounter memorable personalities as you navigate through each perspective, from the hilariously bizarre 'Sergeant Huang' to the bone-chillingly sinister presence of the 'Mad Ballerina'. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/11c6e36944c26a27f8ebc2b7782bab031c9a0c5f.png

Explore a Harrowing Campus: Traverse winding corridors and navigate through a labyrinth of rooms in a beautifully realised Taiwanese university. Utilise the school map to uncover hidden pathways and escape routes while confronting the relentless terrors of your haunting stalkers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833795/1729973b623c9d7529c649d28f320892c0c2642c.png

Solve Mind-Bending Puzzles & Unravel a Chilling Conspiracy: Gather cryptic clues, unearthing artifacts and items scattered throughout the campus bringing you deeper into the hidden conspiracies rooted within Wen Hua.
Out now on Steam! 

PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, GOG and Epic Games Store coming later this year.
